Dashboard_WelcomeText1: Welcome to Marketeer! This plugin allows you to manage and track your market board sales across all your characters and retainers.
Dashboard_WelcomeText2: Use the sidebar menu to navigate between your characters, monitor your financial statistics, analyze your sales history, and track market competition in real-time.
Config_AutomationDelayToggle: Enable randomized delay between automated actions
Config_EnableDebugMode: Enable Debug mode (Verbose logging and developer tools)
Command_Config_Description: Opens the configuration menu. Usage: /marketeer config
